messages:
Lena (Design): quick sync on a compact latency chip idea. goal: show p95 large, tiny inline 8-bin histogram, and a small sample badge. want chips to be scannable in a grid. thoughts?
Noah (PM): love the chip approach for fleet views. key: users must spot regressions and jump to traces quickly. keep p95 prominent, use color + icon for delta.
Devon (Eng): feasible. backend can return p95 + 8 pre-bucketed bins. caveat: exact buckets for every route/window expensive at high cardinality. recommend returning approx buckets and an approx flag.
Ravi (Data): agree. API: GET /metrics/latency?route=...&bins=8&approx=true -> {p95:230, bins:[120,70,30,10,5,2,1,0], sample_rate:0.1}. UI should show a tilde badge when sample_rate<1.
Maya (Accessibility): accessibility nits: do not rely on color alone for regression; add up/down icon and aria-label. heatmap/histogram must be keyboard-focusable and expose text summary for SRs. ensure p95 contrast >=4.5:1.
Lena (Design): microcopy idea: in-card badge: "~" with aria-label "Approximate values (sampling)". hover expands to show full histogram + "Open traces" CTA.
Noah (PM): copy for sampling toggle: "Approximate values from 10% sampling. Run exact query to compute precise metrics (may take 10-30s and increase cost)." Button: "Run exact query"
Devon (Eng): implement exact-run as async job with progress. warn users with modal before running heavy queries. track telemetry when exact queries are requested.
Ravi (Data): also include a confidence field from sketches so UI can show uncertainty (±ms). pair visual cue with text, not opacity alone.
infra-bot: deployed latency-chip-preview to staging at https://staging.redwood/team/dashboards
Lena (Design): I'll post Figma mocks with keyboard flows and microcopy in ~90 mins. Please review before EOD. :eyes:
